technologies.name: LTE
technologies.description: The foundational 4G radio access technology built around OFDMA/SC-FDMA and the flat E-UTRAN architecture.

technologies.name: LTE-Advanced
technologies.description: The first release to meet ITU IMT-Advanced requirements, adding carrier aggregation and higher-order MIMO.

technologies.name: LTE-Advanced Pro
technologies.description: Extends LTE toward 5G-like capabilities with NB-IoT, LAA, and massive MIMO enhancements.

technologies.name: 5G NR
technologies.description: The 5G air interface, supporting both non-standalone and standalone deployments across FR1 and FR2.

technologies.name: 5G-Advanced
technologies.description: The evolution of 5G NR starting at Rel-18, adding AI/ML-native features, NTN, and RedCap enhancements.

technologies.name: IMS
technologies.description: The access-agnostic subsystem delivering VoIP, VoLTE, VoNR, and multimedia services over IP.

technologies.name: EPC
technologies.description: The all-IP core network introduced alongside LTE, comprising the MME, S-GW, and P-GW.

technologies.name: Security
technologies.description: The cross-generation set of authentication, key management, and ciphering specifications.

technologies.name: UMTS
technologies.description: The original 3G system built on WCDMA radio access and an evolved GSM/GPRS core.

technologies.name: GPRS
technologies.description: The packet-switched overlay for GSM, providing the 3GPP packet core lineage that EPC evolved from.

technologies.name: 5GC
technologies.description: The service-based, cloud-native core network architecture underpinning 5G NR.

technologies.name: VoLTE
technologies.description: IMS-based voice service delivered natively over the LTE packet-switched network.
